questions.question: Compare trekking and hiking as adventure activities.
questions.solution_html:
• Compare trekking and hiking as adventure activities.
  • Hiking is a shorter, less demanding activity on well-marked trails, often a day trip
  • while Trekking is a longer, more challenging journey that can last multiple days or
  • weeks, covering rougher terrain and requiring more extensive gear and preparation.

questions.question: Diffrentiate between kayaking and surfing.
questions.solution_html:
• Kayaking is the sport or activity of paddling a small, narrow boat called a kayak
  • using a double-bladed paddle. Paddlers sit facing forward, with their legs in front, and
  • use alternating strokes on each side to move through the water. It can be a relaxing
  • recreational activity or a high-energy competitive sport on various waterways like
  • rivers, lakes, and oceans.
  • Surfing is a water-based adventure sport in which a person, called a surfer, rides on
  • the forward or deep face of moving ocean waves using a surfboard. The surfer uses
  • balance, body movement, and skill to stay on the board while gliding along the wave
  • until it breaks. It is both a recreational activity and a competitive sport practiced
  • mainly in coastal areas with suitable waves.
questions.final_answer: mainly in coastal areas with suitable waves

questions.question: Diffrentiate between kayaking and surfing.
questions.solution_html:
• Kayaking is the sport or activity of paddling a small, narrow boat called a kayak
  • using a double-bladed paddle. Paddlers sit facing forward, with their legs in front, and
  • use alternating strokes on each side to move through the water. It can be a relaxing
  • recreational activity or a high-energy competitive sport on various waterways like
  • rivers, lakes, and oceans.
  • Surfing is a water-based adventure sport in which a person, called a surfer, rides on
  • the forward or deep face of moving ocean waves using a surfboard. The surfer uses
  • balance, body movement, and skill to stay on the board while gliding along the wave
  • until it breaks. It is both a recreational activity and a competitive sport practiced
  • mainly in coastal areas with suitable waves.
questions.final_answer: mainly in coastal areas with suitable waves
